description: He wears an ivory ankle-length tunic with a narrow open neckline, dense woven floral texture and fine gold borders around the neckline, front and cuffs. A long black coat with broad gold geometric and arabesque embroidered edging hangs open over the tunic. A wide ochre-gold patterned woven sash wraps the waist and falls as a long fringed panel at one side. Dark loose trousers appear below the hem. Black-brown closed shoes with elaborate gold embroidery complete the outfit.
